findings.reason: Source eastern braid requires a different branch choice or replacement geometry; it hugs/crosses the vegetated island while the main open water lies west.
The source start of the braid crosses the gravel/island; branch alternatives need a fresh complete-course review.

A source segment cuts a vegetated bend/island near Melrose. Both World Imagery and independent NAIP show the discrepancy. The FWP line is worse; OSM follows the main bend more closely here but has its own discrepancies upstream.

decision: Do not export this candidate. A close mileage match does not resolve observed source-geometry errors. Original agency and OSM geometry and imagery comparisons are retained independently.
